interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Installing street trees or planters would provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Management Measures
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming such as speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this straight residential/mixed-use street.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential block.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while also calming traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high, install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings and appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing points for residents.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Add speed cushions or humps to physically enforce low speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Utility Undergrounding
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to provide a clear walking path and relocate utility lines underground to remove physical obstructions.
